title: Seller Concessions To Buyers - How Much?

faqs.q: What are seller concessions in real estate?
faqs.a: Seller concessions are closing cost contributions from the seller to help buyers complete the purchase.

faqs.q: How much were seller concessions in Phoenix Metro?
faqs.a: Concessions ranged from 0.9% to 2.6% of sale prices across 2,112 closings in the prior 30 days as of February 9, 2019.

faqs.q: Which city had the highest seller concessions?
faqs.a: Glendale recorded the highest average seller concessions at about 2.3%.

faqs.q: Which price range had the most closings?
faqs.a: Homes priced between $200,000 and $300,000 had the most closings, with average concessions of 1.9%.
